intro: Durable and practical, Auraline Ele embraces simplicity through a minimal design that fits seamlessly into modern spaces. With clean lines and functional organisation, it offers a storage solution that feels both practical and effortless.

features.title: Organize Your Wardrobe Your Way
features.text: Thoughtfully designed internal compartments ensures right balance of shelves, hanging space and a built-in locker providing practical storage solutions without any complexity. It meets everyday needs with ease and makes everyday routine a breeze.

features.title: Integrated locker for private, secure storage
features.text: A concealed locker sits discreetly within the design, offering a secure home for documents, jewellery, or valuables. This way, everything sensitive stays private without disrupting the overall layout.

features.title: Sleek handle with lock
features.text: Sleek handles with integrated lock go well with the wardrobe surface, creating smooth, cleaner look. The ergonomic design ensures a comfortable grip while maintaining a minimalist aesthetic. The keys have been designed with 9 wafer wave design for extra security with a longer insert.

features.title: Made to last with durable steel construction
features.text: Built with dent-resistant steel, this almirah is designed to protect your belongings while standing strong through years of daily use.

features.title: Openable skirting for easy cleaning
features.text: Openable skirting allows complete access underneath the wardrobe for thorough floor cleaning. This practical feature prevents dust accumulation in hard-to-reach areas, maintaining hygiene without requiring furniture repositioning.

features.title: Eco-friendly finish for lasting beauty
features.text: Coated with an eco-friendly powder finish, this almirah resists rust and wear, keeping it beautiful and functional for years to come.

name: Auraline Ele 2-Door Steel Almirah Textured London Fog
